newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec in new oil discovery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec in new oil discovery.

text.p: Oil producer Petroleum Securities Ltd (PetSec) said on Thursday it had a new oil discovery and record daily oil and gas production from its Gulf of Mexico, United States oil and gas fields.
PetSec said the Ship Shoal 193-3 exploration well had encountered oil in two separate zones and would be completed as an oil producing well.

It said its West Cameron 543/544-7 well had moved into full production, lifting its total gross production from the Gulf of Mexico to a record high of 71.5 million cubic feet of gas and 8,400 barrels of oil per day.
